instrument.evidence: All peptide samples were separated on an online nanoflow Easy nLC1000 UHPLC system (Thermo Scientific) and analyzed on a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA).

labeling.evidence: Desalted peptides were dissolved in 600 μl of 0.5 M triethylammionium pH 8.5 solution and were labeled with 8-plex iTRAQ reagents according to the manufacturer's instructions (AB Sciex, Foster City, CA).

mass_analyzer.evidence: All peptide samples were separated on an online nanoflow Easy nLC1000 UHPLC system (Thermo Scientific) and analyzed on a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA).
